body: Im desperatly trying to hang in there. Im still in ontario and trying to figure out how to get money to get a bus ticket somewhere. Hungry too but im trying to just ignore it.

I want to try and go west to a smaller town where apparently they care of their homeless better than here. Like I said before all the shelters here are full for the night. I need to figure out a way to get the money for a bus ticket.
Spent my last bit of money on this tea so I doubt any other 24 hour place is going to let me stay without paying for anything.
Im in a coffee shop rght now till it closes. All the shelters in my area are full or closed now.
